reason: The patch moves span-buf:s:{...}:<id> keys from SET to ZSET without changing the key name (buffer.py:196-199 sadd->zadd; add-buffer.lua:45-52 scard/sunionstore->zcard/zunionstore; buffer.py:434 sscan->zscan). Nothing migrates the data, bumps the prefix or reads both types, so ZADD/ZCARD/ZSCAN on a leftover SET key fail with WRONGTYPE and the spans buffered in it are not flushed.
